name: Glynn County, GA
findings: Glynn County has 324 nonprofit organizations. 127 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 100 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Glynn County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Glynn County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 60 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.text: 29 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 14 in similar places of this size.
